question: Who among the following Mughals built Moti Masjid in the Agra Fort complex?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Moti Masjid **is a **white marble mosque** situated in the **Agra Fort** complex in **Uttar Pradesh, India.**
 
• It was built by Mughal emperor **Shah Jahan** between **1648 and 1654 AD.**
 
• The mosque has** three domes and four minarets,** and it is considered one of the finest examples of Mughal architecture.
 
• Shah Jahan built Moti Masjid for his personal use and it was used by the** Mughal royal family** for private prayers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jahangir **was the** fourth Mughal emperor** who ruled from **1605 to 1627 AD**.

 
 
• He was known for his love of **art, poetry, and nature**.
 
 
 
• **Akbar** was the** third Mughal emperor **who ruled from **1556 to 1605 AD**.
 
 
• He was known for his **religious tolerance, administrative reforms,** and **military conquests.**
 
 
 
• **Aurangzeb** was the** sixth Mughal emperor** who ruled from **1658 to 1707 AD**.
 
 
• He was known for his** strict Islamic policies, military campaigns**, and **expansion of the Mughal Empire.**
